results.title: By Design
results.overview: A woman swaps bodies with a chair, and everyone likes her better as a chair.

results.title: Bid16
results.overview: A woman urgently requires access to her storage unit, but her account has gone delinquent and she cannot afford the penalty fees.

results.title: The Love That Never Comes
results.overview: A 40-year-old woman, cynic about love and addicted to failed dates, receives a mysterious anonymous message that leads her on an absurd and emotional journey through digital love...

results.title: GrimTrax Returns
results.overview: Like a comet streaking across the sky with a trail of suffering, ennui, and industrial puncture wounds behind it, GrimTrax Returns! Five shorts too grim to release individually, including one we recorded TWO YEARS AGO and held onto for just this moment.

results.title: Take Off
results.overview: A worker from Northeast China is obsessed with his dream of flying his self-made flying-device.

results.title: Deewana
results.overview: Munna, an ordinary boy in an ordinary world, sees a beauty that feels beyond his reach. While he struggles to become worthy of her, she is quietly learning to leave.

results.title: Mitti De Putt
results.overview: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away. Left with nothing but the land beneath his feet and the promise he makes on it, he sets out to answer blood with blood. To bring his mother home, he must first confront the man who took her, and the price the soil demands is heavier than he knows.

results.title: P.T. Barnum's aberrant circus
results.original_title: El Aberrante circo de P.T. Barnum
results.overview: Philanthropist P.T. Barnum runs a successful traveling circus where he exhibits freaks and deformed people, whom he mistreats and exploits.  Soon, the freaks, led by the Marsupial Man, will rebel in a bloody riot

results.title: Dushi Curaçao
results.overview: Roos travels alone to Curaçao to distance herself from her life in the Netherlands — and from her fiancé Roel, with whom she no longer feels a connection. While those around her believe they’re the perfect couple, deep down Roos knows it’s over. On the island, she meets Stijn, a defense worker, with whom she shares an intense connection. But Roos hides her background and invents a new story about who she is. As the island pulls her further away from home, the truth threatens to catch up with her.

results.title: Gender Studies
results.overview: When a trans college student learns the girl she idolizes is sleeping with their teaching assistant, she takes drastic steps to emulate her.

results.title: Old Knobbley
results.overview: In 17th century England, two women persecuted for witchcraft find sanctuary and safety at the site of a five-hundred year old oak tree.

results.title: Devil Box
results.overview: Kev, a dim-witted office worker, tries to win his father’s favour and save the world after his new mom, Bela, lets him in on a conspiracy involving his younger brother, Kody, and his plans to take over their family business.

results.title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XVIII
results.original_title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XVIII
results.overview: Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XVIII was a professional wrestling event produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and organized by Yuji Nagata. Held on June 20, 2026, at City Gymnasium in Kimitsu, Chiba, Japan, the annual Blue Justice show served as Nagata’s hometown charity event.

results.title: AAA Noche de Los Grandes 2026 - Week 1
results.original_title: AAA Noche de Los Grandes 2026 - Week 1
results.overview: Noche de Los Grandes (Spanish for "Night of the Greats") was a professional wrestling event produced by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA), in partnership with its parent company WWE. The event took place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, at Arena Monterrey in Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico.

results.title: Sport Heart
results.overview: A warm comedy about the collision of two incompatible worlds when young Maja decides to unite her fiancé, the sophisticated man from Belgrade, Pavle, with her father, Macura, the charismatic owner of a bakery in Zemun. While Maya tries to "polite" her father for the fateful family lunch, and Pavle balances the love and influence of his domineering mother, the generation gap and deep-rooted prejudices come to the surface.

results.title: Broken Rhythm: Bruce Lee's Game of Death
results.original_title: Broken Rhythm: Bruce Lee's Game of Death
results.overview: Delving into Bruce Lee's unfinished film, Game of Death, while also exploring the legendary martial arts icon as a real, complex, flesh-and-blood human being.

results.title: Tangkis
results.overview: Tangkis revolves around Fuad, a former national badminton champion who harbors a massive dream of breeding world-class athletes by strictly training his own children.  The film explores themes of high-stakes ambitions, familial sacrifice, and the toxic or difficult balance between rigid sports discipline and a father's genuine love.  While Fuad primarily focuses his efforts on coaching his two sons to make the national team, his daughter, Sara, steps up to challenge his authority as both a coach and a father, igniting deep-rooted emotional conflicts within the household.

results.title: Just One Before I Die
results.overview: Chronicles the unwavering spirit of Buffalo Bills' die-hard fans, affectionately known as 'Bills Mafia', as they navigate heartbreaks and hopes in their quest for an elusive championship.
